messages:
maya: Heads up — noticed a big LCP/first-interactive bump on the console when viewing datasets with lots of annotations (~10k). Happening on prod after the i18n chunk split and the new annotation toolbar rollout. screenshots + perf traces attached in thread.
jai: Thanks. Can you paste the request id / example url? Any canary users seeing it or wide population?
maya: request id  prod:rq_0b9f2a, url /datasets/alpha/annotations?view=grid
maya: Canary % was ~10% yesterday, but telemetry shows spike across all regions so looks rolled further than intended.
rachel: I pulled the trace for rq_0b9f2a — main thread parse up by ~220ms vs baseline. Hot spot is CSS parsing + initial paint after toolbar mounts.
rachel: quick grep from build-stats: 
```
annotation-toolbar.chunk.css: 198.2kb
main.bundle.js: 1.3mb
i18n-eu.chunk.js: 85kb
```
rachel: The toolbar CSS used to be inlined small; now it's a split chunk with a big icon font import (new design). That explains main-thread hit on mobile.
lucas: Hmm — could also be KV cache warm vs cold for chart tiles, but the main-thread parse + chunk size seems like the smoking gun.
jai: Did the routing/quota change a few days ago (we increased routing weight for eu-canary)? Could have increased cache misses and additional i18n chunk fetches cross-region.
maya: We did tweak routing for eu-canary on Tuesday: routing-policy: eu_canary_weight = 0.15 -> 0.4
ci-bot: deploy success 1714989001 — commit c3d2f1f — annotation-toolbar: enable new toolbar by default for canary.
deploy-bot: canary rollout 10% -> 40% (eu) at 1714992000
jai: Ok, immediate mitigation options: 1) rollback toolbar chunking (re-inline CSS), 2) lazy-load toolbar only on hover/click, 3) lower telemetry sampling on annotation pages to reduce main-thread instrumentation.
lucas: 2) is easiest short-term — switch to dynamic import on mount + add skeleton toolbar. That avoids blocking LCP on initial paint.
rachel: Also we can strip the icon font subset to remove ~90kb. Quick patch: replace full font file with subset in build; takes ~30 mins to test.
maya: Users report chart interactions also stutter after initial load — likely combo of CSS parse + main-thread work from telemetry instrumentation. Telemetry sample for interactions doubled last week.
jai: Why did sample double? We had a temporary uplift for a rollout. See: telemetry-config change 1714970000 increased sample_rate from 0.05 -> 0.2 for experiments/annotations.
rachel: I can push a quick config revert to 0.05 for prod now (server-side). That should reduce JS instrumentation callbacks.
lucas: For that request id I traced, instrument callbacks accounted for ~60ms. Reverting should help sub-second fixes.
maya: Can we do 2) + telemetry revert as emergency. I'll open a rollback PR for the font and file a follow-up to re-evaluate chunk split.
ci-bot: PR created: r/redwood/console#4821 — dynamic import for annotation-toolbar (WIP)
ci-bot: PR created: r/redwood/infra#1129 — telemetry sample revert for annotations
jai: Let's gate the dynamic-import behind a feature flag so we can A/B test parity and measure CPU/TTI impact. We don't want to regress behavior for power users.
lucas: Agree. Feature flag = toolbar_lazy_load; default true for now in prod canary.
maya: I'll update rollout plan: quick 10% toggle off for 30min, measure LCP and interaction latency. If good, ramp to 100%.
rachel: Telemetry note: we should add a lightweight flamegraph on the new perf dashboard showing parse vs script time per route so we can triage similar regressions faster.
jai: Good idea. Add a per-route main-thread breakdown (parse / gc / scripting / painting). I'll file an infra ticket.
ci-bot: ticket created infra#3856 — per-route main-thread breakdown dashboard
maya: Timeline: apply telemetry revert (now), enable toolbar_lazy_load behind flag (canary), subset icon font patch (later today). I'll post quick numbers after each step.
deploy-bot: actioned: telemetry revert applied at 1715000400
maya: Telemetry update (1715000600): after revert sample_rate -> 0.05, initial LCP dropped ~120ms on the failing page in canary cohort. Interaction stutter reduced but still ~50ms jitter.
lucas: That matches expectations. Next step lazy-load + skeleton should remove the rest of the delta.
jai: Postmortem action items: 1) tighter review for chunk splits that add >50kb of CSS/js to critical paths, 2) improve rollout gating for UX-impacting features, 3) add main-thread breakdown dashboard.
maya: I'll schedule a 30min postmortem sync with eng-platform + devex tomorrow to decide long-term UI packaging rules.
rachel: Also recommend adding a CI perf check that reports new chunk size delta vs baseline for changed bundles.
maya: Thanks everyone. I'll update thread with the canary numbers after the lazy-load PR lands. :thumbsup:
